item.name: EXTRUDO
item.label: Internal tool
item.description: Upload a flat SVG and the app extrudes it into a 3D icon rendered in WebGL with Three.js. Controls cover depth, bevel, gradient shading, echo copies and shadow, camera presets, and eight brand palette groups plus a custom palette. Settings can be exported or imported as a recipe file, and the result exports as a high-resolution PNG.
